human_signoff_required.item: Freeze complete author list before abstract deadline; no author may be added or removed after the abstract deadline.
Confirm every author has the correct OpenReview profile/email and current affiliation/profile information.
Confirm ICLR 2027 author quota and reciprocal-reviewing obligations for the complete author list; register a qualified reviewer if required by the policy.
Confirm no substantially similar archival submission is under parallel review in violation of the ICLR dual-submission policy.
All authors read and acknowledge the ICLR Code of Ethics and Code of Conduct requirements.
All authors review and approve the mandatory AI-use statement and accept responsibility for the final manuscript and AI-assisted artifacts.
Review the genuine title and abstract used for reviewer bidding before submitting the abstract; do not use a placeholder abstract.
Immediately before OpenReview upload, verify the PDF and supplementary ZIP SHA256 values against this handoff and perform one final anonymity check.
